summary: A 1930 ground cab on Pinyon Peak in the Challis National Forest, drive-up and listed as staffed through 2023; sources disagree on the cab type.

facts.design: Ground cab with hip roof; register says L-4 groundhouse, other sites say R-4 frame cab

access.note: Drive-up per Idaho Fire Lookouts, on Forest Service land. No closure notice, visitor information or road report was found in the sources read.

visit.trail_note: A 1935 newspaper item quoted by the Forest Lookouts site describes a road still being completed toward the station, with the last stretch cut into rock. No current road report was found; check with the Forest Service before driving up.

events.note: Built 1930 per the register and the other lookout sites. The Forest Lookouts site calls it a Region 5 model 4A ground house.
Road toward the station was being completed; about half a mile was still to be built, per a 1935 newspaper item quoted by the Forest Lookouts site
First named lookout on the Idaho Fire Lookouts staff list
Notice asked volunteers to help paint and clean up the historic lookout
Lookout evacuated as the Halstead fire advanced; dated August 4, 2012 on the Forest Lookouts site
Most recent named lookout on the Idaho Fire Lookouts staff list

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says a hip-roof L-4 groundhouse. firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say an R-4 cab. The Forest Lookouts site says a Region 5 model 4A ground house. The story reports the disagreement and does not choose one.

The register gives 9,855 ft (3,004 m). firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give about 9,942 ft. The record keeps the register's 3003.8 m, which matches the register. The story does not give an elevation.

notes_for_editor: Cab type disputed: L-4 per the register, R-4 per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts, Region 5 model 4A per the Forest Lookouts site. The story says so. Elevation differs (3,004 m register vs about 9,942 ft elsewhere); the record keeps the register figure. Access is listed as public on the strength of the drive-up listing and Forest Service land; no closure or current road report was found, so the access note is an open question. Staffing is only known through the 2023 entry on the Idaho Fire Lookouts list; no 2025 or 2026 check. Web searches used: 2. Distinct pages read: 6. Brief's 1930 built year, standing status, NHLR registration date and agency all check out. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the 1935 road is now described as being completed, not pushed up a ridge; the shelf is the last four to six miles of the road; the R-4 frame wording is attributed only to the site that says frame; the 1935, 2006 and staffing years now have their own quotes.
